name: econ-slides
description: Build economics research talks in LaTeX/Beamer: paper-to-talk decks, discussant slides, timed speaker scripts, and edits to existing Beamer decks, each compiled and checked before delivery. Not for PowerPoint or Google Slides.

interface.longDescription: Turn an economics paper into a conference, seminar, or job-market Beamer talk, build discussant slides, write a timed speaker script, or extend an existing deck in its own style. Every number is traced to the paper, and every deck is compiled, geometry-checked, and inspected page by page.
defaultPrompt: Use econ-slides to turn this economics paper into a 30-minute Beamer conference talk with a speaker script.
Use econ-slides to build discussant slides on the attached paper for a 7-minute discussant slot.
Use econ-slides to add mechanism slides and a linked appendix to my existing Beamer deck without restyling it.
